units: <cite ref="Gittin 7a:8">Gitt. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ מנא לן וכ׳</he> how is it proved that music (at banquets, after the destruction of the Temple) is forbidden? <cite ref="Gittin 7a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ז׳ דמנא</he> instrumental music, <he>ז׳ דפומא</he> vocal music.
<cite ref="Sotah 48a:16">Sot. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ בביתא וכ׳</he> music in the house—destruction at the threshold.

<cite ref="Psalms 150">CL</cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200).—Pl. <cite ref="G00053"><he>זִמְרִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="G00538"><he>זִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:2:6">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הוה דמיך וקאים בזי׳</he> used to go to bed and rise with music.—V. <cite ref="G00554"><he>זִמְרָה</he></cite>.
